messages.author: 5cf685ede3c7a045
messages.subject: how to run methylation correlation on ecoli genome?
parts:
I am trying to run this script below but it's not working, presumably because it does not recognise the 'ecoli' string as a known assembly. Is there a way to produce the correlation plots even if ecoli is not known to methylkit?

```
#!/usr/bin/Rscript
library(methylKit)
library(tools)
args<-commandArgs(TRUE)

# readBismarkCytosineReport function
devtools::source_gist("4839e615e2401d73fe51")

file.list = list("/data/group/test/TEST_Run001/TEST_Run001-12345678/mkBS/TST32_103_11-12345678/Data/Intensities/BaseCalls/TST32-103-11_S1_L001_R1_001.cutB_pe.sorted.mrgd.dedupled.n.CpG_report.txt.gz"
,"/data/group/test/TEST_Run001/TEST_Run001-12345678/mkBS/TST32_103_3-12345678/Data/Intensities/BaseCalls/TST32-103-3_S1_L001_R1_001.cutB_pe.sorted.mrgd.dedupled.n.CpG_report.txt.gz"
,"/data/group/test/TEST_Run001/TEST_Run001-12345678/mkBS/TST32_103_5-12345678/Data/Intensities/BaseCalls/TST32-103-5_S1_L001_R1_001.cutB_pe.sorted.mrgd.dedupled.n.CpG_report.txt.gz"
,"/data/group/test/TEST_Run001/TEST_Run001-12345678/mkBS/TST32_103_7-12345678/Data/Intensities/BaseCalls/TST32-103-7_S1_L001_R1_001.cutB_pe.sorted.mrgd.dedupled.n.CpG_report.txt.gz"
)
# This reads straight from the output of bismark, works for both strands
myobj = readBismarkCytosineReport(
        file.list,
          sample.id=list(
strsplit(basename("/data/group/test/TEST_Run001/TEST_Run001-12345678/mkBS/TST32_103_11-12345678/Data/Intensities/BaseCalls/TST32-103-11_S1_L001_R1_001.cutB_pe.sorted.mrgd.dedupled.n.CpG_report.txt.gz"), '[_]')[[1]][1],
strsplit(basename("/data/group/test/TEST_Run001/TEST_Run001-12345678/mkBS/TST32_103_3-12345678/Data/Intensities/BaseCalls/TST32-103-3_S1_L001_R1_001.cutB_pe.sorted.mrgd.dedupled.n.CpG_report.txt.gz"), '[_]')[[1]][1],
strsplit(basename("/data/group/test/TEST_Run001/TEST_Run001-12345678/mkBS/TST32_103_5-12345678/Data/Intensities/BaseCalls/TST32-103-5_S1_L001_R1_001.cutB_pe.sorted.mrgd.dedupled.n.CpG_report.txt.gz"), '[_]')[[1]][1],
strsplit(basename("/data/group/test/TEST_Run001/TEST_Run001-12345678/mkBS/TST32_103_7-12345678/Data/Intensities/BaseCalls/TST32-103-7_S1_L001_R1_001.cutB_pe.sorted.mrgd.dedupled.n.CpG_report.txt.gz"), '[_]')[[1]][1]
               ),
        assembly="ecoli",
treatment=c(1,1,1,0),
        min.cov=10)

meth = unite(myobj)

pdf(file="/data/group/test/TEST_Run001/TEST_Run001-12345678/mkBS/Methylkit.02.Meth_CorrelationPlot.s4.m10.pdf"); getCorrelation(meth,plot=T); dev.off()
```

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] how to run methylation correlation on ecoli genome?
parts:
could you send a reproducible example? The problem is unlikely to be "ecoli" string. Assembly string is for book keeping purposes, we don't run validation on that string unless you are trying to merge data from different assemblies. 

Best,
altuna
